login.title: Log in
login.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask your company's administrator to reset it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.hint: Choose a new password. You will stay logged in here and be logged out on other devices.
changePassword.forcedHint: You logged in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.

company.title: Company settings

company.timezoneHint: Used to decide which day a timesheet entry belongs to

deactivate.title: Deactivate user?
deactivate.description: {{name}} will immediately lose access to this company. Their records stay. You can activate them again later.

activate.title: Activate user?
activate.description: {{name}} will be able to log in to this company again.

reset.description: {{name}} will be logged out everywhere and get a new temporary password, which you will see once.

cancelInvitation.title: Cancel invitation?
cancelInvitation.description: {{name}} will no longer see the invitation. You can invite them again later.

users.invitedToast: This person already has an account, so they were sent an invitation. They get access once they accept it.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Companies that want you to join them
invitations.accepted: You joined {{company}}. Switch to it from the menu with your name.

confirmDecline.title: Decline invitation?
confirmDecline.description: You won't join {{company}}. The company can invite you again later.

hint.ADMIN: Manages company settings and users (except owners)
hint.PROJECT_MANAGER: Manages workers, teams, timekeepers and foremen on their own sites; approves hours

tempPassword.title: Temporary password
tempPassword.description: Give this password to {{name}}. They will have to choose their own password when they first log in.
tempPassword.warning: This password is shown only once and can't be viewed again. If it gets lost, reset the password.

platform.title: Companies
platform.createDescription: Creates the company and its owner. A new owner gets a temporary password.
platform.createdExistingOwner: Company created. The owner already had an account and can log in with their existing password.
platform.currencyLater: Currency (UZS) and time zone (Tashkent) can be changed later in company settings.

deactivate.title: Deactivate company?
deactivate.description: Nobody in {{name}} will be able to work in it until it is activated again. No data is deleted.

activate.title: Activate company?
activate.description: Users of {{name}} will be able to work in it again.

platform.editDescription: Name, currency, time zone and plan.

platform.firstPaidThroughHint: The last month of the first payment or of the trial. The month counts in full, to its last day.

payRules.title: Pay rules
payRules.description: How hours, absences and travel are paid. Changes apply from a month you choose; earlier months keep their rules.
payRules.emptyDescription: Payroll can't be calculated until the pay rules are set up. Some values, like the overtime multiplier, have no default: you enter them.
payRules.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Payroll can't be calculated until an owner or administrator sets up the pay rules.
payRules.noneInForce: No rules apply to this month yet: they start later.
payRules.historyHint: Each version applies from its month until the next one.
payRules.appliesFromHint: These rules apply from this month on, until the next change. Earlier months keep their rules. Locked months can't be changed.
payRules.restWeekdaysHint: Days of the week nobody is due at work. Hours on them are paid as rest-day hours.
payRules.noRestDays: None: every day is a working day
payRules.normalHoursHint: Hours above this on a working day are overtime. Hourly rate = salary ÷ (working days × these hours).
payRules.multipliersHint: Pay for an hour = hourly rate × multiplier. Normal hours are always paid at × 1, so a full month pays exactly the salary.
payRules.overtimeHint: Hours above the normal hours on a working day
payRules.restDayHint: Any hours on a rest day
payRules.holidayHint: Any hours on a public holiday or company day off
payRules.absencesHint: A paid absence pays hours per day × hourly rate. Absences on rest days and holidays are never paid.
payRules.emptyIsNormalHours: Leave empty to use the normal hours per day

travelMode.PER_DAY_WORKED: Fixed amount per working day worked
travelMode.MONTHLY_AMOUNT: Monthly amount entered by the accountant

travelModeHint.NONE: The company doesn't pay for travel.
travelModeHint.PER_DAY_WORKED: Each working day worked pays the amount of the worker's route. Rest days and holidays worked don't count.
travelModeHint.MONTHLY_AMOUNT: The accountant enters a travel amount for each worker every month.

payRules.roundingStep: Round the amount to pay out to the nearest ({{currency}})
payRules.roundingHint: The amount to pay out (pay plus bonuses, minus advances and deductions) is rounded once to the nearest multiple of this amount, halves up. It applies to the whole company, also at sites with their own rules. The difference is shown as its own line.

confirmDelete.title: Delete these rules?
confirmDelete.description: The rules from {{month}} will be removed. From then on, the rules from {{previous}} will apply.
confirmDelete.descriptionNoPrevious: The rules from {{month}} will be removed. From then on there will be no pay rules until new ones are set.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Days off and swapped working days. They decide each month's working days.
holidays.addDescription: Uzbekistan's fixed-date public holidays are already included. Each year, add the moving holidays, extra days off and your company's own days off.
holidays.name: Holiday
holidays.noteHint: Optional, e.g. which day a working day is swapped with
holidays.missingDescription: Not entered yet: {{names}}. Until they are, the year's working days and hourly rates are wrong.

kindHint.RAMAZON_HAYIT: A moving public holiday, announced each year. One day: extra days off around it are "Extra public day off".
kindHint.QURBON_HAYIT: A moving public holiday, announced each year. One day: extra days off around it are "Extra public day off".
kindHint.PUBLIC_EXTRA: A day off the government declares.
kindHint.COMPANY_DAY_OFF: A day off for your company only. Hours worked on it are holiday hours.
kindHint.WORKING_DAY: A rest day that becomes a working day: the other half of a day-off swap the government declares.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this day?
confirmDelete.description: {{holiday}} will be removed. The working days of its month will be recalculated.

workingDays.title: Working days
workingDays.description: Working days per month: calculated from the rest days and holidays, or set by hand. Hourly rates use the "Used for pay" column.
workingDays.lockedHint: This month is locked. Its working days can't be changed.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Construction sites, their teams and who works on them
sites.name: Site name
sites.codeHint: Optional short code, e.g. from your accounting
sites.emptyDescription: Add your first site, then its teams and workers.
sites.emptyDescriptionNotAssigned: You aren't assigned to a site yet. Ask your company's administrator.
sites.notFoundDescription: This site doesn't exist or you don't work on it.
sites.staffHint: They see and work only on the sites they are assigned to.
sites.staffDialogHint: Project managers and timekeepers who work on {{site}}.
sites.noCandidates: Everyone who can be assigned is already here. Add users with this role first.

confirmClose.title: Close site?
confirmClose.description: {{name}} will be closed: no new teams or workers can be added there. Its history stays.

confirmReopen.title: Reopen site?
confirmReopen.description: {{name}} will be open for teams and workers again.

teams.name: Team name
teams.foremenDialogHint: Foremen who lead {{team}}. They see and work only with their own teams.
teams.emptyTitle: No teams on this site yet
teams.emptyDescription: Add teams to group workers and give them a foreman.

confirmClose.title: Close team?
confirmClose.description: {{name}} will be closed: no workers can be placed in it. Its history stays.

confirmReopen.title: Reopen team?
confirmReopen.description: {{name}} will be open for workers again.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: People who work on your sites, and where they work
workers.addDescription: The worker’s details and where they start. Salary is entered separately by the accountant.
workers.name: Name
workers.emptyDescription: Add workers with the button above.
workers.personalDataHint: Not shown to timekeepers and foremen.
workers.move: Move to another site or team
workers.moveHint: Their current placement ends the day before. Earlier days stay where they were.
workers.rehireHint: They start again from the day you choose.
workers.leaveHint: The last day they work. Days after it are not theirs any more.
workers.salaryHint: A salary applies from the chosen month until the next salary. Salaries are never changed: a raise or a correction is added as a new one.
workers.salaryViewHint: Salary history. The owner, an admin or the accountant adds salaries.
workers.salaryCorrects: {{month}} already has a salary. The new one corrects it.
workers.monthlySalaryHint: A worker who works every working day at normal hours earns exactly this amount.
workers.salaryReasonHint: Optional, e.g. raise, correcting a mistake
workers.noSalaryYet: No salary has been added yet.
workers.setShiftHint: The same shift from a day for several workers. Each keeps it until a newer one.
workers.shiftHint: A shift applies from its day until the next one. A night shift that ends after midnight counts on the day it ends.
workers.noShiftYet: No shift yet: the normal hours of the pay rules apply.

confirmRemoveShift.title: Remove this shift?
confirmRemoveShift.description: {{name}}: “{{row}}” will be removed and the shift before it will continue. The change is recorded in the audit log.

workers.shiftUnchanged: The worker is already on this shift from that day.
workers.shiftsSetSome: Shift set for workers: {{added}}. Already on it: {{unchanged}}.

impersonation.bannerDetails: Everything you do is recorded as done by {{by}} on their behalf. Ends at {{time}}.

subscription.graceTitle: The subscription was not renewed. Last month paid: {{month}}
subscription.graceDescription: Everything still works until {{date}}. After that the company becomes read-only until the payment is received. Contact the system operator to pay.
subscription.readOnlyOwner: You can view and export everything, but nothing can be changed. Contact the system operator to pay.
subscription.readOnlyMember: You can view and export everything, but nothing can be changed until your company renews its subscription.

platformUsers.title: All users
platformUsers.description: Every account on the platform, in every company
platformUsers.createDescription: Creates an account with a temporary password. Add the person to a company afterwards.
platformUsers.editDescription: Name, phone and email. The person logs in with the phone or the email.
platformUsers.membershipDescription: Put {{name}} in a company with a role, or change their role or access there.
platformUsers.membershipIncomplete: Choose a company and a role.

deactivate.title: Deactivate account?
deactivate.description: {{name}} will be logged out everywhere and can’t log in until the account is activated again. No data is deleted.

activate.title: Activate account?
activate.description: {{name}} will be able to log in again.

reset.title: Reset password?
reset.description: {{name}} will be logged out everywhere and get a new temporary password, which you will see once.

impersonate.title: Log in as this user?
impersonate.description: You will see and do exactly what {{name}} can, for up to one hour. Everything you do is recorded under both your names.

grantAdmin.title: Make platform administrator?
grantAdmin.description: {{name}} will be able to manage every company, account and plan.

revokeAdmin.title: Remove platform administrator?
revokeAdmin.description: {{name}} will no longer manage companies, accounts and plans.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: What companies pay for: a limit of active workers and the modules included
plans.createDescription: Users and sites are never limited, only active workers.
plans.editDescription: Companies on this plan this month or from next month: {{companies}}.
plans.termsFixed: Price, worker limit and modules can’t change once a company has had this plan. For new terms, make a new plan and move companies to it.
plans.name: Name
plans.maxActiveWorkersHint: Workers with a placement in a month. Above this, no new worker can be added.

archive.title: Archive plan?
archive.description: {{name}} will no longer be offered. Companies that have it keep it.

restore.title: Offer plan again?
restore.description: {{name}} can be given to companies again.

monthlyHours.title: Monthly hours
monthlyHours.description: Each worker’s total hours and days for the month, without a daily timesheet
monthlyHours.emptyDescription: Workers who were employed on at least one day of the month show here.
monthlyHours.dialogHint: Entered hours are never changed: a correction is added as a new entry.
monthlyHours.lockedHint: The month is locked, so its hours can’t change.
monthlyHours.dailyEntriesHint: The worker has daily timesheet entries this month, so the hours come from those.

hint.normalHours: On working days, up to the normal hours per day
hint.overtimeHours: On working days, above the normal hours per day
hint.workdaysWorked: Working days with hours worked (travel pay per day counts these)
hint.travelDays: Moving between sites, working days only

monthlyHours.noteHint: Optional, e.g. why it was corrected
monthlyHours.dialogHintShift: Shift {{name}}, {{hours}} normal hours per day. Entered hours are never changed: a correction is added as a new entry.
monthlyHours.outdatedHint: These hours are for days that are no longer one part of the month, so they count for nothing. Enter the hours of each part again.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.description: Bonuses, advances and deductions for each worker’s month
adjustments.emptyDescription: Workers employed on at least one day of the month show here.
adjustments.noteHint: Optional, e.g. what the bonus is for or the advance receipt number.
adjustments.addHint: Bonuses are added to pay; advances and deductions are taken off it. Enter the amount without a minus sign.
adjustments.lockedHint: The month is locked, so adjustments can’t be added or cancelled.
adjustments.viewOnlyHint: Only an owner, administrator or accountant can add or cancel adjustments.
adjustments.cancelHint: The entry stays in the list, marked as cancelled, and no longer counts in pay. The reason goes into the audit log.

payroll.title: Pay calculation
payroll.description: Each worker’s pay for the month, and where every amount comes from
payroll.workersWithProblems: Workers who can’t be paid yet: {{count}}
payroll.emptyDescription: Workers employed on at least one day of the month are paid here.

problems.twoSources: This month has both daily timesheet entries and monthly hours. Keep only one.
problems.noRules: No pay rules for this month: {{sites}}.
problems.noCompanyRules: The company’s pay rules for this month are missing. They hold the rounding step.
problems.totalsInvalid: The monthly hours don’t fit the month (the pay rules may have changed):
problems.invalidHours: The daily timesheet entries contradict each other.

totalsProblems.NORMAL_ABOVE_DAYS_WORKED: more normal hours than the working days worked × normal hours per day
totalsProblems.WORKDAY_HOURS_ABOVE_DAYS_WORKED: more hours on working days than the working days worked × 24
totalsProblems.DAYS_ABOVE_WORKING_DAYS: more days than the month’s working days

lines.travelNoRoute: Travel pay: days: {{count}}, no route set

payroll.lockHint: A locked month can't change. Its results are saved.
payroll.lockAfterEnd: A month can be locked only after it has ended.
payroll.lockNeedsAll: Every worker must be payable before the month can be locked.
payroll.lockedHint: The month is locked. Only an owner can reopen it.
payroll.lockDescription: {{month}}: workers: {{count}}, total {{total}}. These results are saved and the month can no longer change.
payroll.unlockHint: An unlocked month can change again. The reason goes into the audit log, and the earlier results are kept.
payroll.lockHistoryHint: What each lock saved, and what changed since the lock before.
payroll.noChanges: No differences from the lock before.
payroll.owesHint: Advances and deductions are more than the pay for this month. Nothing is carried to the next month by itself.

timesheet.title: Timesheet
timesheet.description: Daily hours per worker. Pick a site and a month, then type the hours into each day.
timesheet.noSitesDescription: Hours are entered per site. Once you work on a site, it appears here.
timesheet.emptyTitle: Nobody works on this site this month
timesheet.emptyDescription: Workers placed on the site, and anyone with hours here, appear in the timesheet.
timesheet.noRulesTitle: Rest days and holidays aren’t marked
timesheet.noRulesDescription: Pay rules for this month aren’t set yet, so the calendar doesn’t know the rest days.
timesheet.lockedHint: This month is locked. Its hours can’t be changed.
timesheet.readOnlyHint: You can view these hours. Entering them is done by the people Settings allow.
timesheet.moduleOffHint: This month’s plan doesn’t include the Timesheet module. You can view the hours, but not enter them.
timesheet.monthlyTotalsHint: Some workers have monthly totals for this month, so their days can’t be entered here.
timesheet.howToEnter: Select a day and type the hours (for example 9 or 7,5) or one of the codes below, then press Enter. Delete clears the day.
timesheet.invalidCell: Type hours from 0 to 24 (for example 9 or 7,5) or one of the letter codes.
timesheet.codesMissingTitle: Some absences have no code yet
timesheet.codesMissingManager: Hours can be entered already. To enter absences, add your company’s codes for them.
timesheet.codesMissingMember: Hours can be entered already. Absences without a code can be entered once an owner or administrator adds the company’s codes.

timesheetSettings.title: Timesheet entry
timesheetSettings.description: Who enters the daily hours on site.
timesheetSettings.entryRolesHint: Owners and administrators can always enter and correct hours.

scope.TIMEKEEPER: On the sites they are assigned to

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: The letters your company uses for absences in the timesheet.
codes.hint: Everyone in the company types the same codes, whatever their language. Hours are typed as a number. Each absence shows in the timesheet with the code ticked for it; its other codes can be typed too. Changing a code changes no hours already entered.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Shifts with their own normal hours per day, e.g. a 10-hour night shift. A worker without a shift has the normal hours of the pay rules.
shifts.name: Name
shifts.normalHoursHint: Used instead of the pay rules on the days a worker is on this shift: for the hourly rate, overtime and absence hours.
shifts.emptyDescription: Shifts are optional. Without one, workers have the normal hours of the pay rules.
shifts.dialogDescription: A night shift that ends after midnight counts on the day it ends.
shifts.hoursFixed: A worker has had this shift, so its hours can’t change: that would change months already worked. For other hours, add a new shift.

archive.title: Archive the shift?
archive.description: “{{name}}” will no longer be offered. Workers who have it keep it.

restore.title: Bring the shift back?
restore.description: “{{name}}” can be given to workers again.
